integrity: The derivation is exact for every cycle length at least three and every nonnegative palette size; standalone finite tests reproduce the claimed specializations. Self-review only, without independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula concerns vertex-labeled sunlets with one leaf per cycle vertex; no unicyclic generalization or symmetry-orbit count is claimed. Originality comparison is literature-dependent.
title: The strong odd coloring polynomial of sunlet graphs
